Question B-003-012-010.

Why the correct answer is right: On lower sideband, the RF tone appears below the suppressed carrier setting; 1000 Hz is 1 kHz, so 7100 kHz - 1 kHz = 7099 kHz.

Why the distractors are wrong:
- sourceIndex 1: "7101 kHz": This adds the 1 kHz tone as if the transmitter were using upper sideband.
- sourceIndex 2: "6100 kHz": This subtracts 1000 kHz instead of converting 1000 Hz to 1 kHz.
- sourceIndex 3: "8100 kHz": This adds 1000 kHz instead of converting the tone to 1 kHz and using the lower-sideband direction.
